name: setBusinessAccountProfilePhoto
description: Changes the profile photo of a managed business account. Requires the _can\_edit\_profile\_photo_ business bot right. Returns _True_ on success.

parameters.name: business_connection_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the business connection

parameters.name: photo
parameters.description: The new profile photo to set

parameters.name: is_public
parameters.description: Pass _True_ to set the public photo, which will be visible even if the main photo is hidden by the business account's privacy settings. An account can have only one public photo.
